title: What Counts as One Backtest?

launchpad.outcome: Tell a real rep from screenshots, candles and imagined setups, then log one rep.

items.text: Setup formed in replay. You evaluated it, took it and logged it.
Three screenshots of that same trade.
items.why: Screenshots belong to the rep. They aren’t reps.

items.text: A setup that would have formed if price had pulled back more.
Setup formed. Your rules said no. You passed and logged the pass.
items.why: A logged pass on a real opportunity is a rep.

items.text: Re-running a session you’ve already seen.
items.why: You know the ending. That’s review.

slides.title: Log one rep
lines: Run one opportunity and save it. Notice: one rep, three screenshots attached.
slides.principle: A rep only helps if you know exactly what you’re repeating.

takeaways: One rep = one independently evaluated opportunity.
remember: A rep only helps if you know exactly what you’re repeating.
